findings.problem: No input source exists for regionLabel
findings.why_it_matters: This causes differences from the installation location and duplicate data management
findings.example_failure: HQ guesses and enters the region for each job
findings.required_fix: Use the installation property as the only source
findings.suggested_revision: IR25: siteAddress=Property.address; null when not registered

findings.problem: redactedReportSummary is free text with no redaction rules
findings.why_it_matters: Post-expiry visibility cannot be implemented unambiguously
findings.example_failure: Addresses or phone numbers remain in the report body
findings.required_fix: Limit it to the approved report-availability and acceptance states
findings.suggested_revision: IR25: Three ReportHistorySummary states; freeze the latest visible version when access ends

findings.problem: The summary API cannot accept the job screen status and severity conditions
findings.why_it_matters: The requirement to use the same conditions for the list and KPIs cannot be met
findings.example_failure: The warning list also displays critical counts
findings.required_fix: Align job summary filters and projection rules
findings.suggested_revision: IR26: Add job conditions for partner/technician; reject them for customer

findings.problem: The requirement to show a disabled reason after a capability change has no output field
findings.why_it_matters: The customer screen cannot retrieve the reason without audit permission
findings.example_failure: Only enabled=false is shown and the disabled reason is lost
findings.required_fix: Define Repository-generated disabled reasons and when to clear them
findings.suggested_revision: IR27: disabledReason; validation and clearing on explicit re-enabling

findings.problem: The DD requires a reason only for updates; the type also requires it for creation
findings.why_it_matters: Implementations of new-entry input may differ
findings.example_failure: Creation sends an undefined dummy reason
findings.required_fix: Make it optional on creation and required on updates in types and validation
findings.suggested_revision: IR28: changeReason is optional; an existing ID requires a nonempty value

findings.problem: The stated operation count is 135, but the catalog contains 136
findings.why_it_matters: Handover may wrongly identify an operation as missing
findings.example_failure: Implementing 136 operations may be judged to include an extra operation
findings.suggested_revision: Correct it to 136 and check the count with the validator

rounds.focus: Text, DTOs, catalogs, and acceptance criteria for six corrections; old address prohibition; report-version freezing; disabled reasons on re-enabling
